page.content:
Half-elf rogue who becomes the Champion of the Raven Queen.

How Vax'ildan connects

  • Faction: Vox Machina — Vax'ildan is the rogue of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Liam O'Brien — Liam O'Brien plays Vax'ildan.
  • Character: Vex'ahlia — Vex'ahlia and Vax'ildan are twins in Vox Machina.

What is Vax'ildan?

Vax'ildan is Liam O'Brien's Campaign 1 rogue, twin of Vex, who takes the Raven Queen's champion mantle and does not walk out of the Vecna fight the same way.

Key threads lead to Vox Machina, Liam O'Brien and Vex'ahlia.
